correctness.rationale: Every endomorphism is a nearest-neighbor walk. Idempotence fixes its connected interval image pointwise; the exterior tails are independent nearest-neighbor walks. Reflecting the image interval gives the unique centered fixed-image case, and Burnside for C2 yields all orbit sizes. Matrix resolvents are formal geometric series. In the stable range k>d, endpoint-started walks of length at most d cannot step outside the far boundary, giving the ballot/reflection-principle central-binomial count. Direct enumeration for n=2..14 and all ranks confirms 5515 actual idempotents; finite checks do not prove the theorem.

value.rationale: An idempotent is a natural algebraic retraction and its image rank is intrinsic; conjugacy under the unit group is a canonical isomorphism invariant. The theorem supplies the complete distribution by image rank and orbit stabilizer for infinitely many transformation monoids, not merely total counts. The two-tail decomposition explains the symmetry fixed points and reveals a universal near-full-rank stabilized profile, useful when comparing the idempotent structure of path monoids across sizes. These are structurally motivated complete invariants, not ad hoc finite tables.
